__STUB__
Single seagull dives past midground, wings catching sun-glare bright-white, she watches laughing.
Cresting wave curls at midground, spray-arc backlit gold, she raises hand shielding eyes.
Pink hanabi-firework bursts deep-distance over bay, water mirrors bloom, she gasps softly.
Light rain-shower drifts midground over water, rainbow edge forming, she tilts face upward.
Tiny crab emerges from sand-hole at her feet, claw raised curious, she crouches delighted.
Paper-lantern lifts deep-distance over bay, single amber glow rising slow, she points excitedly.
Rainbow-arc saturated bright overhead after sun-shower, she stretches arms wide in afternoon light.
Shooting-star streaks deep-distance dusk-sky, faint silver trail fading, she clutches hat brim.
Silver fish-school flashes past midground shallows, scales glinting, she steps back surprised smiling.
Sun breaks cloud-bank, gold-rays touching wave-tops midground, she shields eyes hand-visor style.
Tiny child chases seagull deep-distance, both mid-arc joy, she watches clapping hands.
Pelican glides across midground frame low, wings fully spread bronze, she tracks it quietly.
Barrel-wave rises at midground glassy-green, hollow curl visible, she leans forward watching intently.
Sparkler-trail burns deep-distance over bay, faint gold arc, she whispers something to companion.
Passing rain-curtain sweeps distance over water, she spins once catching cool edge-drops.
Ghost-crab scuttles sideways into frame near her towel, she jumps back laughing brightly.
Floating-lantern releases on water midground, warm glow drifting outward, she kneels watching.
Spray-rainbow forms midground off breaking wave, brief prismatic arc, she reaches toward colors.
Meteor-trail crosses deep-distance above ocean horizon, she freezes mid-step, eyes wide upward.
Minnows scatter in shallow water at midground, silver flash sudden, she watches from shoreline.
Sudden gold sun-burst lens-flare midground as cloud parts, wave-tops ignite, she squints smiling.
Tern hovers above wave midground, wings trembling still, she points quietly to companion nearby.
Shore-break collapses with white foam at midground, backlit spray rising high, she steps back.
Small group of kids mid-jump-laugh at midground, she grins watching from her beach chair.
